info.title: Angelic Booking API
info.description: Business-scoped REST API. Authenticate with an API key from Settings → API access, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Each key has scopes (`x:read`, `x:write`); a write scope implies its read scope. Rate limit: 120 requests per minute per key; every response carries `X-RateLimit-*` headers.

bearer.description: An API key from Settings → API access.

Error.description: An error. `error.code` is machine-readable; `error.message` is for people.
